label: PF Backlog 593
title: EDP prerequisite: no PostgreSQL installed/provisioned or bootstrapped for PF's system of record
body: Gap found during EDP-17 (BI-PF-1309): the repo had DDL migrations + a migration runner (go/migrate) but NOTHING to provision/connect/apply them - no Postgres installed or running, no PF_DB_DSN/connection config, no pool client, no bootstrap/deploy step, no schema_migrations ever created. (The POSTGRES_* code in docker_compose_generator/service_catalog is for GENERATED products, not PF's own SoR.) Resolution: added docker-compose.edp.yml + config/database.json + PF_DB_DSN env flag + scripts/dev/db_bootstrap.py (EnsureTable -> apply migrations/*.up.sql, idempotent) + runbook in docs/EDP-17-SCHEMA.md. Remaining: env must actually be provisioned to run it.
